notes.title: NEW Little Dungeon Stories Update! - v1.0.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34984392/324133b7b2f9c9f1991fc51d91ed2dcacf61f8ac.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Sorry for taking so long to update the game, I was busy with some aspects of life. But during this time I have added lots of cards and more content like a new Effect to the game, I hope you like it!

Let's see what this update contains:

[h2]ːwinter2019happybulbː NEW CONTENT ːwinter2019happybulbː[/h2][list]
[*] Added 4 new potions
[*] Added 4 new weapons
[*] Added 1 new props
[*] Added 2 new NPC
[*] Added 4 new Items
[*] Added 14 new enemies
[*] Added 3 new traps
[*] Added new sounds
[*] More minor adjustments & bug fixes
[/list]

Have a nice weekend and thanks for supporting me! ːwinter2019happyyulː

David.

notes.title: NEW Little Dungeon Stories Update! - v1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34984392/324133b7b2f9c9f1991fc51d91ed2dcacf61f8ac.png[/img]

Hello everyone! This will be the first and last update of the year, but more will come next year with new cards and features. 

Let's see what this update contains:

[h2]ːwinter2019happybulbː NEW CONTENT ːwinter2019happybulbː[/h2][list]
[*] Kickstarter credits.
[*] Added 3 new potions.
[*] Added 5 new weapons.
[*] Added 2 new props.
[*] Added 1 new NPC.
[*] Added 2 new enemies.
[*] Added 2 new traps.
[*] Achievements now work correctly (open your game and they will pop up!)
[*] Minor adjustments & some more bug fixes.
[/list]

Have a Happy New Year and thanks for supporting me! ːwinter2019happyyulː

David.

notes.title: As First Himno (F2P) Hits 250,000 Downloads We Are Very Happy To Announce Himno - The Silent Melody
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/351ccefbb96df8aca3592a1c53540a87119fa8ab.jpg[/img]

Himno - The Silent Melody is the standalone roguelike combat expansion of the peaceful game Himno. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange machines, beautiful procedurally generated maps, and surprises. Craft powerful gear, find other explorers and save this old world.
